描述_EN: it would have been placed on a wooden stand and used for daily personal ablutions. basins like this were used as wash basins. this basin is made of paktong, literally 'white brass'. the material has a high zinc content and was commonly used to make domestic objects like basins and locks.
描述_ZN: 它将被放置在一个木架上，用于日常的个人洗漱。 像这样的盆子被用作洗脸盆。 这个盆子是由paktong制成的，字面意思是 "白铜"。 这种材料有很高的锌含量，通常用于制造盆和锁等家用物品。
